procedure: Build sourced drivers and coherent cash flows.
Apply matched discount convention and supported terminal economics.
Reconcile the single claims bridge and share rights.
Rebuild material sensitivities and verify formulas with actual tool coverage.

acceptance.expectation: History, projection identities, cash flow, discount timing and claims bridge reconcile with documented tolerance.
Growth, reinvestment, return, rates, cash-flow claim and ownership policies are mutually consistent.
Sensitivity includes base tie and all affected model changes; invalid parameter combinations are explicit.
Workbook formulas remain editable when provided; native recalculation and rendering are separate tested states.

conditions: Required input unavailable or hash/version stale
Acceptance is failed or not performed
failure.record: failure_records with affected record, missing evidence/test, consequence, owner, next action and interim conclusion restriction

artifact_alias_semantics: Logical plan output names for the corresponding method records, not extra completed artifacts. Preserve unit, current version and actual completion/review state; a design or formula specification is not an executed model or reconciled numerical bridge.
